compiled_state.title: GREEN: Implement detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh — a bash helper that examines a git diff and identifies applicable cleanup recipes from the registry.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the detection script to make RED tests from be56-3751 pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh and is executable
- Reads staged diff via git diff --cached (or accepts --diff-file=<path> for test injection)
- For each file in the diff, extracts file extension and maps to applicable cleanup recipes:
  - .py → check normalize-imports (python) recipe in registry
  - .ts / .tsx → check normalize-imports (typescript) recipe
  - .rb → check normalize-imports (ruby) recipe
- Only outputs recipes that exist in the registry (no phantom recipes)
- --format=json flag: outputs JSON array [{"name": "normalize-imports", "language": "python"}]
- No diff / no applicable recipe types: exits 0 with no output
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env var overrides registry path (required for test isolation)
- All tests in test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh pass

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests pass

## Dependencies
- be56-3751 (RED tests must exist first)

AC amendment: Add standard universal criteria and failure mode coverage per AC library Script/Tooling category.

## Acceptance Criteria (supplemental)

Universal Criteria:
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: true  # shell script — no ruff check required

Script/Tooling Criteria (AC library category):
- [ ] Script exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh
- [ ] Script handles no arguments gracefully (exit 0, no output)
  Verify: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 0
- [ ] Script outputs JSON array with --format=json for applicable recipes
  Verify: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/recipes/recipe-registry.yaml bash plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh --diff-file=<(echo 'diff --git a/foo.py') --format=json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin)' && echo OK || echo 'JSON parse failed'
- [ ] All tests in test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-detect-cleanup-recipes.sh

Failure mode coverage:
- [ ] Missing RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH → exits non-zero with error to stderr
  Verify: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=/nonexistent plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh 2>&1; test $? -ne 0
- [ ] Empty diff / no staged files → exits 0 with no output
  Verify: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/recipes/recipe-registry.yaml plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh --diff-file=/dev/null 2>/dev/null | wc -c | awk '{exit ($1 > 0)}'
- [ ] Diff with unsupported file extension (e.g., .go) → exits 0 with no output
  Verify: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/recipes/recipe-registry.yaml plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes.sh --diff-file=<(echo 'diff --git a/foo.go') 2>/dev/null | wc -c | awk '{exit ($1 > 0)}'

Testing Mode: GREEN — make failing tests from be56-3751 pass
